title: Failure Capsule: make the failure portable
audience: Developers handing a bounded failure to an inheritor without handing over machine state or secrets.
promise: Capture one declared failure, redact sensitive output, preserve omissions and artifact identity, and leave reproduction as an explicit next action.
story: A repository-declared command fails with a target and exit code that can be identified.
Secret-like output is redacted before persistence while omitted capture classes remain labeled.
An allowlisted artifact is represented by size and hash rather than copied indiscriminately.
Inspection opens the capsule without executing the failed command.
verified_locally: Failed declared command captured as a bounded local capsule.
TOKEN-like output redacted and secret value absent from the persisted excerpt.
Allowlisted artifact identity, omissions, and inspect-only opening preserved.
Current dev tests, lint, and package checks pass at revision 516f24f.
The 1600×900 PNG preview is visually reviewed and legible at the target crop.
open_gates: Connect one capsule to Evidence Replay and preserve the producer envelope.
Expand cancellation, malformed-input, and explicit-recovery scenario receipts.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves the current dev bounded-capture slice and local binary preview; it does not claim Replay handoff, complete recovery coverage, hosting, or publication.
